latency.elapsed_seconds: wall time from start to finish of the extraction jobs on a ready server, including client preparation and validation; excludes model startup and local mask application
latency.http_seconds: sum of completed generation HTTP requests

selection.equivalent_groups: Both holdout inputs have at most two original fragments, so adjacent pairs and the entire document yield identical source and context in this validation.
selection.resource_controls: Run the same two-thread reference for every model and preserve each finalist tested thread and slot counts. Add a matched four-thread serial control for any four-thread concurrent finalist.
